name: Sendou Chiri
source:
"I'm Chiri Sendo. A detective in Sagami City... I patrol the streets alongside my superior, Senji Hiizumi. I hope we can get along."

A female detective working directly under Senji Hiizumi at the Sagami Police Station. She's serious and capable.

She seems to have some kind of secret... but then again, doesn't everyone? She gets caught up in a major incident alongside [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url]. Hopefully, she makes it out safely.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category5&ch=sendo]official website[/url]]
